_readme: Tim's permanent answer key (owner 2026-09-29: 'Tim is only going to get smarter the more he's used'). Every case is a real sentence a contractor said, scrubbed of names, and what Tim must make of it. The nightly retrain ADDS cases from contractors' fixes (td_tim_asks kind 'fix'); a case is never deleted or loosened to make a change pass. steps: lines that must appear in timSaySteps. notSteps: text that must not. materials: exactly the list timSaidMaterials returns, as 'qty unit item'.
